summary: Iteration 6: Verified the RevenueCat entitlement-id fixes. Full unlock flow now works end-to-end. Env var updated to 'Scripture council Pro' + permissive fallback in checkProEntitlement/purchaseMonthly successfully unlocks Pro on 'Test valid purchase'. Persistence across reload confirmed. Pro features (unlimited counsel, Share PNG download) work. Failed-purchase regression correctly leaves paywall open. Restore invalid-email validation works; valid-email restore path did not surface an observable toast within the 6s window (may need longer wait or minor UX gap).

pro_feature_usage.unlimited_counsel_two_additional_questio: PASS (no paywall for 'What is love?' and 'How to forgive?')
pro_feature_usage.share_verse_png_download: PASS (james-1-3.png downloaded, toast 'Verse image downloaded — share it with a friend.')
pro_feature_usage.listen_audio_button: INCONCLUSIVE - button clicked and moved to PREPARING state, but no <audio> element was created within 6s of wait. May be slow ElevenLabs response, or audio may play via Web Audio API without an <audio> tag. Needs manual verification / longer wait.

regression_restore_flow.invalid_email_validation: PASS - toast 'Please enter a valid email address.' appears
regression_restore_flow.valid_email_no_subscription: PARTIAL - no observable toast within 6s wait; restore modal remained open. Expected 'No active subscription found' toast per spec.

integration_issues.issue: No visible toast within 6 seconds after clicking Restore Access with 'realrestore@example.com'. Expected 'No active subscription found' message per spec. Modal remains open. Could be async delay or missing error surfacing.
Play button transitions to PREPARING but no <audio> element observed after 6s. Could be legitimate ElevenLabs latency or audio playback not exposing an <audio> element. Recommend manual verification.

action_items: Verify restore flow surfaces 'No active subscription found' toast for a valid email with no entitlement (may need error handling on the RC identify/getCustomerInfo path in the restore handler).
Confirm audio playback works with ElevenLabs — either wait longer than 6s or verify audio playback mechanism. Consider adding a data-testid on audio element or on the 'Playing' state for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: The permissive entitlement check (unlock on ANY active entitlement) is a good safety net and now allows a working purchase flow despite the dashboard's non-conventional 'Scripture council Pro' identifier. Consider still fixing the dashboard identifier (rename to 'pro') as best practice.
Restore flow needs clearer async feedback — a loading state on the Restore Access button and a guaranteed toast on both success and 'not found' cases.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (unlock + persistence + Pro Share verified; Listen and Restore-not-found need follow-up)

Verified persistence, unlimited counsel, and Share PNG. Two minor follow-ups: (1) restore flow with valid email + no subscription — no toast surfaced within 6s; recheck with longer wait or add error handling. (2) Listen/audio button transitions to PREPARING but no <audio> element within 6s — needs manual verification or longer wait.
rca of the issue: Iteration 5 identified RC dashboard entitlement id mismatch. Main agent's fixes (env='Scripture council Pro' + permissive Object.keys(active).length>0 fallback in revenuecat.js) resolve the issue. 'Test valid purchase' now returns status='unlocked', paywall closes, Pro pill shows, and Pro state persists across reload via RC customerInfo.
